hits.about: Binghatti Apex is an amazing project by Binghatti located in the heart of the JVC neighbourhood. The majestic tower rises 45 storeys above the city and offers elegant studios and luxurious 1-bedroom apartments. There are office spaces on four floors.The facades of the building have a unique design that combines both modern and traditional Middle Eastern styles, while glass panels add to the architecture of the building's uniqueness. The interiors are also designed in a contemporary style using the highest quality finishing materials.Among the facilities at Binghatti Apex, every resident will find something to do for leisure and recreation. For the active lifestyle enthusiast, the complex offers a gym with state-of-the-art equipment, a tennis court, jogging tracks and a large swimming pool. Children can play on the playground or in the children's pool, and residents can relax and unwind with gazebos, recreational areas and a dedicated outdoor yoga or aerobics area.The unique strategic location of the complex is another of its features. One of Dubai's main motorways, Al Khail Road, is in close proximity, allowing residents to quickly access key points of the city. The Mall of Emirates shopping centre is a 15-minute drive away, the Burj Al Arab, Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall are all within a 20-minute drive, while Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport are approximately 30 minutes away.
hits.title: Binghatti Apex
